watch.summary: A Valorant player frantically clears the site while holding angles for his team, only to realize the last enemy was already dead.

beats.what: Streamer plays intensely while text overlay labels him as unaware.
The enemy dies, but the streamer misses the top bar notification.
Streamer nervously checks every corner and holds angles thinking enemy is near.
Streamer looks at the top bar and realizes the enemy is already dead.
Streamer bursts into hysterical laughter recounting how paranoid he was.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The contrast between the creator's hyper-focused, paranoid game play and the reality that the round was already over creates instant comedic irony. His genuine, hilarious reaction upon realizing his mistake seals the punchline.
